lines.en: I hop through the vines.

lines.zh: 绿色的胶体里浮着草叶。
lines.en: Grass blades float in the green gel.
Each landing sticks for a moment.
A patch of leaves goes down with me.
The jungle floor is soft.

lines.zh: 我跳起来的时候能看见树顶。
lines.en: When I hop, I see the treetops.
Landing, there is only leaves.
I grow spikes.
They catch on the vines.
I roll over a fern.
That fern is flattened under me.
The damp makes me heavier.
I can still hop.

lines.zh: 我跳过的藤蔓，全沾着绿胶。
lines.en: Every vine I hop past is smeared with green gel.
The vines bend under me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方全是黏液。
lines.en: Everything I cross is left slimy.
I rest and swell slowly.
Drops fall from the spikes.
The ground under me is damp.

lines.zh: 我的胶体里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves inside the gel.
Leaves I swallowed.
I swell my body once.
Then shrink back again.
Monkeys call in the trees.
They will not come down.
A leaf falls onto me.
I swallow it in.
There are grass seeds in my gel.
You stand among the vines.
I am close to you now.
You have no spikes.
But spikes grow on my back.
There is mud on your hands.
I am covered in spikes.
Neither is a good thing.

lines.zh: 我盯上你踩在藤蔓上的脚。
lines.en: You're standing in vines, mud all over your soles.
The jungle is like this anyway.
You took half a step forward.
Some gel has come off me.
A few spikes are bent.

lines.zh: 我塌了半边，又慢慢鼓起。
lines.en: Half of me collapsed, then slowly bulges back.
That wound is nothing.
My gel drips down.
Where it falls, grass grows.
Part of me collapses.
Then slowly swells back.

lines.zh: 我两根刺断了，胶还在往下滴。
lines.en: Two spines snapped, and gel still drips.
Gel still seeps from the breaks.
That thing in your hand.
I cannot make it out.
My eyes are inside the gel.
What colour is that in your hand?
I cannot tell colours apart.
You threw it on the ground.
I cannot see it at all.
The smell is faint as well.
Have you brought the wrong thing?

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西不够塞的。
lines.en: What you hold is not enough to plug anything.
Touch me and you are pricked.
The spikes carry venom.
Best not to touch a second time.
You stepped onto me.
A spike went through your sole.
You jump clear off the ground.

lines.zh: 我在你脚还没抬的时候就挪了。
lines.en: I moved before you lifted your foot.
A green puddle stays on the ground.

lines.zh: 你的靴底粘上了我的胶。
lines.en: My gel is stuck to your boot sole.
Every step sticks fast.
You will want to scrape it off.
You crouch to deal with it.
I wait beside you.

lines.zh: 我贴在你鞋底上跟了一路。
lines.en: I rode along on your boot sole.
We are nothing but gel.
Gel does not pair off.

lines.zh: 我连自己有几只都说不清。
lines.en: I cannot even say how many of me there are.
We scatter and gather, that is all.
Do not bring that up.
Gel does not seek out gel.
We merely end up in the same place.
There is nothing for us to discuss.

lines.zh: 你要真想要答案，是没有。
lines.en: If you want an answer: no.
I truly cannot say more.

lines.zh: 我压过叶子，它粘在刺上。
lines.en: I roll over a leaf; it sticks to my spines.
I press over it and it sticks.
That counts as eating.
The leaf sticks to me.
Spiked gel jumps higher.
In a while it dissolves.
It is caught on my spikes.
I cannot shake it loose.

lines.zh: 我压过去的时候它已经烂了。
lines.en: It had rotted before I pressed on it.
Rotten things get eaten too.
You are on my landing spot.
I bounce up, vines still swaying.
Do not just stand there.
Let me try one hop.
You shrank a step back.
So you understand.

lines.zh: 我的黏液已经渗到你鞋底。
lines.en: My slime has already seeped under your sole.
Hopping beats walking.
The grass at your feet is moving.
That is my slime.
I shift closer, hop by hop.
The ground gets stickier.
You make noise walking.
I land on a vine and bounce.

lines.zh: 每次弹起来我都看你一眼。
lines.en: Each bounce, I glance at you.

lines.zh: 我从藤蔓上弹起，落到你背后。
lines.en: I bounce off the vine and land behind you.
You are not looking this way.
I wait behind the vines.
The leaves hide half of me.
I bounce to your flank.
I press my whole body onto you.
The spikes go in first.
Then the venom.
You shake your hand from the sting.
The venom works slowly.
You will feel numb first.
Your hand jerks back at the touch.
I wrap over you once.
Spikes come from every side.

lines.zh: 你挣出去的时候掉了东西。
lines.en: You dropped something getting free.
A lump rises under the ferns.
I squeeze out slowly.
This place is very damp.
I like it here.
I push out from the rotting leaves.
I snapped this vine.
It is hot and close here.
The jungle rain has just stopped.
The puddles have not dried.
I come out from under the leaf litter.
Fire touches me and the gel bubbles.

lines.zh: 我从藤上滑下去，散了一块。
lines.en: I slide off a vine and part of me scatters.
The water loosens me a little.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的胶吹得一片。
lines.en: The blast sprays my gel wide.
An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.
That light hardens my gel.

lines.zh: 饿的时候我缩得比现在小。
lines.en: Hungry, I shrink smaller than this.
Lightning strikes and my spikes carry fire.
The spikes on me are all green.
